en.name: Refried beans
en.summary: Canned refried beans keep about 3 years from purchase in the cupboard, unopened. Once the can is opened they are a wet, cooked, low-acid food and keep only 2–3 days refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below — a much shorter window than most people expect from a tin.
en.pantry: An unopened can keeps about 3 years in a cool, dry cupboard. What buys that is the commercial heat processing and the sealed can, not the beans or the fat in them, so it ends the moment the seal is broken — an opened can is not a pantry item under any circumstances. Do not store cans somewhere hot or damp, since a rusted or dented seam is what eventually fails, and discard without tasting any can that is bulging, leaking, or hisses or spurts when you open it.
en.fridge: Once opened, transfer the beans to a clean covered container rather than leaving them in the can, and refrigerate at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for 2–3 days. That short window is because refried beans are exactly what bacteria like: mashed, moist, starchy, low in acid and often enriched with fat. Smooth the surface flat and cover it closely so it does not dry and crust. Reheat only the portion you are eating, until it is steaming hot all the way through, rather than warming the whole tub repeatedly.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is given for refried beans here, so none is offered — but they do freeze well, and it will be safe indefinitely at −18 °C (0 °F). If you have opened a large can, freezing the surplus in flat, meal-sized portions is far more sensible than trying to stretch the two-to-three-day fridge window. Thawed refried beans are a little looser; beat them in a hot pan with a splash of water and they come back together.
en.thawing: Thaw overnight in the fridge, or reheat straight from frozen in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot. Never thaw on the counter, and do not refreeze once thawed.
spoilage: A bulging, leaking or badly rusted can, or one that hisses on opening — discard unopened or untasted.
Bubbles, froth or a lifted, spongy texture in the paste.
Any mould at the surface, or a slimy sheen.
tips: Never store an opened can in the fridge; decant into a covered container.
Freeze the surplus from a large can in flat portions on the day you open it.
Smooth and cover the surface so it does not crust and dry.
Reheat by the portion, not the whole tub.

faq.q: How long do refried beans last once opened?
faq.a: 2–3 days in a covered container at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Unopened, the can keeps about 3 years.
No timeline is published here, but they freeze well and are safe indefinitely at −18 °C. Freeze the surplus in flat, meal-sized portions.

faq.q: Can you keep beans in the opened can?
faq.a: No. Move them to a clean covered container — an opened can is not a storage vessel.

zh.name: 墨西哥豆泥
zh.summary: 罐頭墨西哥豆泥未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算約 3 年。罐頭一開，它就是含水、熟製、低酸性的食物，冷藏 4 °C 以下只有 2～3 天——比大多數人對「罐頭」的印象短得多。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐頭放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃約 3 年。撐起這段時間的是商業加熱殺菌與密封罐體，不是豆子或裡面的油脂，所以封口一破就結束——開過的罐頭在任何情況下都不是櫥櫃食品。罐頭不要放在濕熱的地方，因為最後會失效的是生鏽或凹陷的罐緣；脹罐、滲漏，或打開時發出洩氣聲、噴出來的，請直接丟棄，不要試吃。
zh.fridge: 開封後把豆泥移到乾淨的加蓋容器，不要留在罐子裡，放 4 °C 以下 2～3 天。期限這麼短，是因為墨西哥豆泥正是細菌喜歡的東西：搗成泥、含水、澱粉多、酸度低，而且常常額外加了油脂。表面抹平、緊密覆蓋，才不會結皮變乾。復熱時只加熱你要吃的那一份，熱到中心冒蒸氣，不要整盒反覆加熱。
zh.freezer: 這裡沒有給墨西哥豆泥的冷凍期限，所以本頁不提供——但它確實很耐凍，在 −18 °C 下安全性是無限期的。如果你開了一個大罐，把多的按一餐份量壓平冷凍，遠比硬撐那兩三天的冷藏期合理。解凍後的豆泥會比較稀；在熱鍋裡加一點水攪打，它就會回來。
zh.thawing: 冷藏隔夜解凍，或直接從冷凍下鍋加一點水加熱到冒蒸氣。不要放室溫退冰，解凍後也不要再冷凍。
spoilage: 罐頭脹罐、滲漏、嚴重生鏽，或打開時有洩氣聲——不要打開也不要試吃，直接丟棄。
聞起來發酸或有發酵味。
豆泥裡有氣泡、浮沫，或整體變得蓬鬆像海綿。
表面長霉，或出現黏滑的光澤。
tips: 開過的罐頭絕不要整罐冰；倒進加蓋容器。
開大罐的當天就把多的按份量壓平冷凍。
表面抹平並緊密覆蓋，才不會結皮變乾。
一份一份復熱，不要整盒加熱。

faq.q: 墨西哥豆泥開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 加蓋容器、4 °C 以下，2～3 天。未開封的罐頭約 3 年。

faq.q: 墨西哥豆泥可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 這裡沒有公布的期限，但它很耐凍，−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的。多的請按份量壓平冷凍。

faq.q: 可以直接把開過的罐頭放冰箱嗎？
faq.a: 不行。請移到乾淨的加蓋容器——開過的罐頭不是保存容器。
